reference_answer: Specify the benchmark versions and provenance. For Terminal-Bench 2.1 / DeepSWE v1.1, vendor-reported percentages are: Qwen3.8-27B 73.0 / 42.2; GLM-5.3 88.2 / 66.9; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 90.6 / 74.2. OpenAI reports DeepSWE v1.1 at max effort for GPT-6 Sol 68.8 and Luna 66.6. No verified Terminal-Bench result for GPT-6 Sol or Luna was found in the cited primary sources at this cutoff; mark those cells unavailable, rather than substituting GPT-5.6 or guessing. These rows use different harnesses, inference settings and sometimes different sampling, so they are not controlled head-to-head results.

sources.title: OpenAI: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Coding section reports DeepSWE v1.1: Sol max 68.8%, Luna max 66.6%; it does not report Terminal-Bench scores for these two models.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B model card
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Benchmark table: Terminal Bench 2.1 (Terminus) 73.0; DeepSWE 1.1 42.2. DeepSWE uses Claude Code with 256K context.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 model card
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Benchmark table: Terminal Bench 2.1 88.2; DeepSWE v1.1 66.9. Notes identify Claude Code for Terminal-Bench and mini-swe-agent for DeepSWE.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model card
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: Benchmark table: Terminal-Bench 2.1 pass@1 90.6; DeepSWE v1.1 resolved 74.2. Minimal DeepSeek Harness and mini-SWE settings are described; cross-harness scores differ.

sources.title: DeepSWE leaderboard
sources.snapshot_or_excerpt: v1.1 leaderboard updated September 22, 2026; shows GLM-5.3 max near 69% and not every model listed in the prompt. Distinguish leaderboard rows from vendor self-reports.

ambiguities: 'Terminal-Bench' does not name a version; versions 2.1, 3.0 and 4.0 have different scores.
Vendor model-card results use different harnesses and evaluation settings; direct ranking is only tentative.
Absence of a verified published GPT-6 Terminal-Bench score is not a score of zero.
decision_changing_errors: Inventing GPT-6 Terminal-Bench values or replacing GPT-6 with GPT-5.6.
Presenting differently configured benchmark rows as a controlled comparison.
Confusing Qwen3.8-27B with Qwen3.8-Max, GLM-5.3 with GLM-5.3-Flash, or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with V4 Flash.
